name: IRSC
description: IRSC is a zero-shot evaluation benchmark for assessing embedding models' performance in multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) tasks across five retrieval subtasks, introducing new metrics for semantic comprehension and retrieval capability.
reputation: A niche but useful zero-shot benchmark for multilingual RAG retrieval evaluation that is still relatively new and not yet widely standardized in the embedding-model community.
notes: Includes five retrieval tasks and introduces two new evaluation metrics: Similarity of Semantic Comprehension Index (SSCI) and Retrieval Capability Contest Index (RCCI).
